scientific_integrity: Prior nonequivariant forest and path results, and pre-existing path reversal fixed/character calculations, are explicitly credited; only the equivariant model and integral quotient classifications are claimed as added conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary independence complexes of uniform-arm spiders and the literal arm-permutation group, not all trees
Equivariant models are homotopy, not PL homeomorphisms; geometric fixed-orbit model is PL
Finite enumerations corroborate but do not prove arbitrary-parameter equivariant or quotient statements
Equivalent unindexed results and inaccessible full text of Kawamura (2010) remain publication-priority risks
title: Permutation-sphere models and projective reflection quotients of spider independence complexes
